backward_compatibility.evidence: Legacy fields remain accepted. pos is additive.

conflict_detection.evidence: If pos and a legacy selector disagree, the handler returns pos_conflict instead of silently choosing one.

blast_radius.evidence: Service-layer contracts were not changed; only tools-layer decoding and schemas changed.

findings.summary: Adding pos could have broken existing clients if legacy fields were removed.
findings.fix: Legacy fields remain supported and are only optional in schema.

findings.summary: pos paths containing slash could be misparsed.
findings.fix: shared:, prompt:, and command: are parsed as single-payload selectors before slash segmentation.
